intro: Today's tech landscape is dominated by a major leadership shakeup at Nvidia following Jensen Huang's resignation. Meanwhile, major model updates from OpenAI and Google are reshaping the capabilities of current foundation models.

must_know.title: ‘It’s a mistake’: reactions from tech leaders on Jensen Huang’s resignation
must_know.summary: Tech industry figures are reacting to Jensen Huang's resignation from Nvidia, which follows reports of personal misconduct involving an alleged spy and a subordinate.
must_know.why_it_matters: The sudden departure of a key industry leader, particularly one central to the global AI chip infrastructure, creates significant market and corporate instability.

must_know.title: The unfolding Jensen Huang scandal: a timeline
must_know.summary: Jensen Huang has officially resigned as CEO of Nvidia following a scandal involving alleged affairs. Experts are concerned about the implications for U.S.-China technology relations.
must_know.why_it_matters: The intersection of executive misconduct and critical geopolitical infrastructure creates high-stakes risks for international stability.

must_know.title: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen, finally replacing 3.8 Flash
must_know.summary: Google has launched Gemini 4 Hydrogen, which is designed for a rapid deployment model rather than the more cautious release cycles of previous iterations like Carbon and Argon.
must_know.why_it_matters: A shift to a faster release cadence for Gemini models indicates Google's urgency in maintaining parity with industry competitors.

big-tech.title: Google’s new Gemini model is better at understanding complicated questions
big-tech.summary: Google's Gemini 4 Hydrogen model has been updated to better handle multi-part, complex, or ambiguous user queries. It is now available across Google's Gemini application and search tiers.
big-tech.why_it_matters: Improvements in parsing complex logic are critical for maintaining the utility of AI assistants in everyday search tasks.

hardware.title: Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility
hardware.summary: Nvidia privately confirmed to U.S. officials that implementing chip tracking for anti-smuggling measures is technically feasible, contradicting public claims of infeasibility made by industry groups.
hardware.why_it_matters: This discrepancy highlights the complexity and internal pressure surrounding export controls and global chip supply chain security.

foundation-models.title: Introducing Images 2.6
foundation-models.summary: OpenAI has released Images 2.6, which introduces faster generation, integrated GIF creation, and more precise editing capabilities. The update includes new API controls and enhancements for ChatGPT and Codex.
foundation-models.why_it_matters: Faster and more precise image generation tools improve usability for developers and creative users.

foundation-models.title: How Amplitude ships product improvements in 1–2 days with OpenAI
foundation-models.summary: Amplitude reports that its internal product agent, Wave, utilizes OpenAI models to identify product opportunities and assist in shipping improvements within 1-2 days.
foundation-models.why_it_matters: AI-driven product agents are demonstrating significant efficiency gains in enterprise software development and deployment workflows.

policy.title: United Airlines blocks AI agents from booking flights, citing cybersecurity risks
policy.summary: United Airlines has officially blocked the use of AI agents for flight booking and reservation management, citing concerns over cybersecurity. The move reflects growing caution among airlines regarding automated third-party AI interfaces.
policy.why_it_matters: Companies are increasingly setting boundaries to manage the risks associated with autonomous agents interacting with their service platforms.

tools.title: Humble Bundle redesign removes two-factor verification from settings
tools.summary: Humble Bundle users have reported that the store's redesigned settings page no longer allows for the management or addition of two-factor authentication methods.
tools.why_it_matters: The removal of core security features in a platform redesign poses significant privacy and account security risks to users.
